name: Fry's Island
text: Fry's Island, also known as De Montfort Island, is an island in the River Thames in England. The island is on the reach above Caversham Lock at Reading, Berkshire. The centre of Reading is to the south and the suburb of Caversham to the immediate north.

depictions.name: Fry's Island
depictions.text: Fry's Island was a small island in the River Dee south of Deebury. It featured one small Anglo-Saxon farmstead. In the 9th century, it was raided multiple times by Viking shieldmaiden Eivor Varinsdottir of the Raven Clan, Vagn, and their raiding crew on his longship.
